description:
Save the owner's setup answers and progress. Send only what changed; returns the new status.
uses_goals: agents | chat | build | media | team. uses_agents: openclaw | hermes | cursor | n8n |
own_code | other. pays_for: providers they already pay for (e.g. "codex", "gemini_cli", "minimax").
free_keys_chosen: free providers they will get a key for (e.g. "groq", "mistral").
skipped_steps: step numbers they chose to skip. state "done" closes setup.
It cannot turn on pool sharing or change the dashboard view: those are the owner's own act in the
browser. Teammates are proposed with gate_invite_contributor, not here. It adds no keys and sends no
invites. A 403 means your key's role cannot write; it does not mean the API is broken.
